title: Plain catalog names for the shipped contracts
summary: The installed read, draft tools and runner contracts are installed under plain names (captured-source-read, draft-validate, draft-format, captured-template-render, draft-text, captured-template-input, draft-result, runner-task, runner-local, runner-read and the rest), each operation with one name for key and handler. The original -v1 entries stay installed byte for byte so existing pins verify and old handlers still dispatch; installedReadAliases(), draftToolAliases() and runnerAliases() send records that still name an old contract to its plain entry, and compiledAliases() rebuilds a harness's alias table.
